name: ai-meta-route-context
description: Resolve personal tool-route and path shorthand into route context before agent execution, so high-frequency tool-routes can move from lookup docs into prompt-time facts.

interface.shortDescription: Injects resolved personal tool-route and path context.
interface.longDescription: Adds deterministic route-context facts for personal shorthand such as gtd plan, draft, snippet, writing.md, $46, and llm-council. Ordinary keyword, path, host, and injected-route rules are loaded live from ~/.ai/route-context.json, so data-only changes do not require plugin reinstall. GitLab URLs also provide parsed hostname, repository, and MR IID when available. It does not execute writes or change the user prompt.
defaultPrompt: Resolve route context for this prompt.
